messages:
noah: Quick flag — noticed a bunch of requests from project `proj-42` showing up under org `redwood-internal` in the dashboard. Quota spikes and the billing link points to the org, not the project. Anyone seen this mapping before?
anya: Ugh. Is this the origin header vs exchange bug again?
noah: Possibly. I captured a trace: `x-redwood-origin: project:proj-42` but the attribution service returned `org:redwood-internal` when we enriched.
danielle: Could also be token-exchange path: the proxy is doing an impersonation exchange and attaching the org claim from the service account. We've seen similar when SA claims aren't canonicalized.
sam: Do we have telemetry for the claim reconciliation flow? I thought the dashboard had a sampling key for exchange events.
noah: Sampling is on, but the UI groups by effective_owner which is org-level. We lose project-level breadcrumbs in the sales-facing dashboard. That makes quota alerts noisy.
anya: Proposal: in the console we should show both attributed_owner and effective_owner with a small callout explaining why they differ. That way support can triage faster.
danielle: Agreed. For rollout: add an additional metric `auth.exchange.project_overrides` that increments when exchange returns project claim != request header. Keep it off by default on prod until we confirm low-cardinality.
sam: Devops question — will that metric cause high cardinality explosion? If we tag it with `reason=claim_mismatch` and `source=auth-proxy` should be fine. But don't tag with full key id.
oops-bot: Deploy scheduled: auth-proxy v2.14 -> canary on infra-qa at 2025-06-02T09:00UTC.
noah: Thanks. For the short term: can we add a dashboard panel that filters quota alerts to only fire on `attributed_owner.project_id` when present, fallback to org otherwise? That should reduce noise for teams using project-scoped keys.
danielle: I can add a grafana panel and a companion alert rule. Want me to open the PR for the metric first or the panel?
anya: Metric first so the panel can consume it. Also add a migration note in the rollout doc: if you see decreased alerting, that's expected while we flip attribution precedence.
sam: I pushed a tiny change to attribution service to prefer explicit `project` claim over derived org if present. PR: <https://git.redwood/repo/attribution/commit/abc123>. Can we canary that with the auth-proxy canary?
oah: Yes, canary them together. Sam, tag the canary with `canary=auth-exchange-claim-fix` and I'll coordinate support coverage.
danielle: I'll prepare the metric PR: `auth.exchange.project_overrides` with tags `source` and `env`.
oah: One more UX ask — on the console quota page, show a tiny inline tooltip when quota is billed to org vs project explaining the precedence rules and timeline for the rollout. 
anya: I'll add that to the rollout doc. Also ping @support on the next release note so CS can update customers that rely on project-level billing.
sam: FYI, found one edgecase: SDK retries that reissue the exchange will occasionally attach old org claim. I'm adding a small TTL to cached claims in the proxy to reduce stale claims.
oah: Great. Timeline?
danielle: Metric PR today, canary w/ proxy + attribution tomorrow, dashboard alert change after metric lands. Support note and tooltip in the console next week.
anya: :thumbsup:
noah: Ok, filing a followup thread for post-canary observations. Thanks all.
